## 专业说明 {#overview}

<p><strong>官方名称：</strong>Studio Art/Integrated Design and Media</p>

<p><strong>授予学位 / 项目类型：</strong>BFA/MS</p>

<p><strong>目录适用期：</strong>2026-2027</p>

<p><strong>条目类型：</strong>combined bachelor pathway</p>

<p><strong>申请路径：</strong>Combined bachelor/graduate pathway; the graduate component is not an independent undergraduate award</p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>目录学位与年度：</strong>官方本科目录登记学位／路径：BFA/MS；资料期为2026-2027。目录年度不能单独证明该项目已开放下一入学年度申请。</p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>课程表举例：</strong>目录所列课程包括：Writing as Inquiry；Advanced Writing and Research；Art and Contemporary Culture I；Contemporary Art: Professional Practices；Global Histories of Art；History of Art Since。这是课程表的部分例子，可能含选修或备选项；不构成全部必修清单。</p>
